title: Koharu
summary: Local-first manga translation project with image/archive/PDF imports, separate OCR/detection/inpainting stages, local GGUF and hosted translation options, manual cleanup and layered exports.
documentation_observations: README documents local GGUF translation, model-specific vision stages and WebGPU canvas editing.
Project documentation says layered PSD export and platform-specific hardware support; operational quality not independently tested.
limitations: Official documentation reviewed, but not installed or benchmarked by NaughtyBoddy. Low-refusal behavior, actual quality, privacy, performance and current release availability are not proven.
